title: Turn Any Small Venue Into a Portrait Studio With One Light
excerpt: Jiggie Alejandrino ran a 50-person portrait station in a small brand-launch venue with a single Profoto B10X Plus shaped into a book light. His 1/320s, f/2, ISO 100 recipe kills ambient light so the strobe does everything, and a foam-board version gets you close on a budget.

title: RAW Editing Just Moved Into Your Browser, Free to Start
excerpt: Skylum launched Luminar on Web, a browser-based photo editor that handles RAW files. The basic version is free forever and full access is a one-time $69, a new low-friction doorway into real RAW editing for learners.

title: High Camera Prices Are Not Proof Camera Makers Are Greedy
excerpt: DPReview's Dale Baskin argues that rising camera prices reflect real design and manufacturing costs, not greed. His reframe for buyers: stop asking why makers are greedy and ask whether the camera is worth it to you.
